title: WeatherUtils
description: See the current weather, type of weather, time until the next weather, and time elapsed, all from a client sided HUD and command!
body:
# ☁️ Weather Utils
**The definitive modern HUD for Minecraft weather forecasting.**

Weather Utils provides a sleek, non-intrusive heads-up display that tracks exactly when the next weather cycle will occur. Whether you're planning a harvest, preparing for a channeling-enchanted strike, or timing complex redstone logic, you'll never be caught in the rain again.

## 🚀 Key Features
* **Precision Tracking:** Get real-time countdowns for **Rain**, **Thunderstorms**, and **End Flashes**.
* **Server-Side Synergy:** While the client predicts, installing on the server provides **100% frame-perfect accuracy** by pulling data directly from the world state.
* **Minimalist Aesthetic:** A highly configurable HUD designed to stay out of your way until you need it.
* **Utility Commands:** Quickly check weather stats or toggle HUD elements via custom commands.
* **Optimized for Automation:** Perfect for players managing farms or weather-dependent machines.

## ⚠️ Compatibility
* **Incompatible with:** Exordium.
